scientific_scope_status: For locally integrable real symmetric S(t), U'=SU, U(0)=I and B(t)=integral S, define r(B)=lambda_max-lambda_min, c(r)=(r cosh r-sinh r)/r^3 with c(0)=1/3, and Lambda=integral c(r(B))||[B,[B,S]]||. The proposed tensor comparison is exp(-2Lambda)exp(2B)<=UU^T<=exp(2Lambda)exp(2B), hence ||U||<=exp(lambda_max B+Lambda) and sigma_min U>=exp(lambda_min B-Lambda). No small total strain or convergent infinite Fer/Magnus product is assumed. The note also scopes bounded self-adjoint Hilbert-space drivers with norm-Bochner integrability, not unbounded operators with moving domains.
